problem_statement: kwork_thread() in sched/wqueue/kwork_thread.c exits its work loop after processing exactly ONE work item per wakeup. Apps PR #1665 adds wqueue.c to ostest: it queues a sleep_worker followed by 100 count_workers, then calls ASSERT(call_count == 100). On the base kernel, only one count_worker runs per wakeup cycle — the remaining 99 are starved until the test timeout fires, causing ASSERT to fail and ostest to abort. The fix changes kwork_thread to drain ALL pending work items in a single pass before sleeping again.
